user.title: Log in to e-park
user.description: Enter the email and password you use in the e-park app. The default recipient gets the permit receipt when a service call names no e-mail or phone; the permit dispatcher example only asks for a phone number, so it needs the default e-mail.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate e-park
reauth_confirm.description: e-park rejected the stored password for {email}. Enter the current password of the e-park app.

reconfigure.title: Default recipient
reconfigure.description: Where the permit receipt goes when a service call names no e-mail or phone. Clear a field to remove that default.

error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new password works; e-park is loading again.

issue_permit.name: Issue guest permit
issue_permit.description: Issue a temporary parking permit to a license plate.

license_plate.name: License plate
license_plate.description: Plate the permit will apply to (spaces are removed, upper-cased).

duration_minutes.name: Duration (minutes)
duration_minutes.description: How long the permit should be valid for (1-1440).

email.name: Recipient e-mail
email.description: E-mail address for the permit receipt (falls back to the default recipient).

phone.name: Recipient phone
phone.description: Phone number for the SMS receipt (falls back to the default recipient).

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional short note on the permit.

pool_id.name: Pool id
pool_id.description: Specific guest pool id (only needed with more than one pool; default: the first).

stop_permit.name: Stop permit
stop_permit.description: End an active permit early (only for pools that allow early stop).

lookup_plate.name: Look up license plate
lookup_plate.description: The car behind a Danish license plate (brand, model, colour, year) from the motor register.

license_plate.name: License plate
license_plate.description: Plate to look up (spaces are ignored).
